Name: Fs - Minecraft Grass Block Shirt
Author: milocoolguy06
Description:
This is a content pack for Fashion Sense.
It adds a Minecraft grass block shirt to the game.

[b]How do I install the mod and make it ready to use?[/b]
Extract the folder you downloaded, and place it into SMAPI's 'Mods' folder.

[b]How to equip the shirt?
[/b]Buy the hand mirror at Pierre's general store (costs 1500). When you're in the hand mirror menu, go to the shirts tab and there you'll find it.

[b]Additional info
[/b]The shirt does NOT have sleeves.
The sleeves in the mod are from another mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13393]SB's oversized sleeves
[/url]The hair is from this mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13042]Ace's fashion sense hairstyles[/url]
